newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's 3-yr yields end lower on rate cut hopes.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's 3-yr yields end lower on rate cut hopes.

text.p: Yields on three-year corporate bonds ended lower after fluctuating on Friday on active buying boosted by hopes for a cut in the reserve requirement ratios, dealers said.
Three-month CD yields closed slightly higher and the overnight call rate edged up, they said.
* 3-yr corporates close at 11.95 pct vs Thursday's 11.98
* 3-mth CDs end at 13.90 pct vs Thursday's 13.80
* Overnight call average at 14.30 pct vs Thursday's 14.05
Relatively scanty new issuances also helped boost buying in corporate bonds, dealers said.
New issuances were estimated at around 42.5 billion won on Friday, compared with a daily average of more than 100 billion won, they said.
Yields on three-month certificates of deposit closed slightly higher in slow trading.
